title: The 3 safety rules every travelling child should memorise before any family trip ✈️👧🏻
description:
The 3 safety rules every travelling child should memorise before any family trip ✈️

I teach my kids these every single time before we enter an airport.

Not after something goes wrong.
Before anything can even happen.

Because family travel is magical…
but crowded places move fast.

Thousands of people.
Announcements everywhere.
Kids distracted by everything they see.

And it only takes one moment for a child to walk a few steps too far.

So these are the 3 safety rules my kids know by heart.

Rule #1: If you can’t see mummy or daddy… STOP walking.
Don’t keep going.
Don’t try to find us somewhere else.
Stop. Stay where you are. We will find you faster.

Rule #2: Look for a safe adult.
Airport staff.
Security officers.
A mum with kids.
Then say clearly:
“My parents are looking for me.”

Rule #3: Always know your full name.
And if they’re old enough, they memorise one parent’s phone number too.

Simple rules.
But rules that can make a huge difference.

And here is something I learned as a mum…

Teaching kids safety rules is powerful.
But being prepared as a parent matters just as much.

That is exactly why Barry and I created KidsFlyer™.

Not because we wanted to sell clothes.
Because we are parents who know how quickly crowded places can turn overwhelming.

KidsFlyer™ is the world’s first safety travel outfit for kids, designed specifically for busy places like:

✈️ Airports
